title: TagDuel LP atomic storage fault-injection matrix

scenarios: Malformed persisted source/Fire Princess ledger JSON is rejected without changing the session.
A source-only partial ledger is rejected; no missing Fire Princess event is written.
A stale LP snapshot is rejected before revision, LP or ledger changes.
Tampered next-source ledger arrays are rejected before commit.
A SQLite BEFORE INSERT trigger aborts ledger persistence; the prior LP/revision UPDATE must roll back atomically.
A duplicate plan without both persisted ledger entries is rejected rather than treated as a replay.

limitations: The suite tests the M454/M452 storage contract in an isolated SQLite database; no live Discord session or production DB is used.
No card certification is added; central resolver integration remains blocked by M61 handoff.
